create_RemBertConfig: create a RemBertConfig instance with default RemBERT model hyperparameters
initialize_RemBertConfig: initialize a RemBertConfig with custom vocab_size, hidden_size, and num_hidden_layers
build_RemBertModel_config: build a RemBertConfig and pass it to RemBertModel to initialize the transformer model
access_model_config: access the RemBertConfig from an instantiated RemBertModel via model.config
configure_RemBert_dropout: configure RemBertConfig with custom hidden_dropout_prob, attention_probs_dropout_prob, and classifier_dropout_prob
